description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files in a project to verify that certain module specifiers referencing 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/' subpaths are properly exported in package configuration files and entrypoints. It reports violations where references are missing from exports or entrypoints, aiding in maintaining module integrity and correct import mappings.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads the project's package.json and extracts the export paths starting with './plugin-sdk/'. Returns a set of subpaths relative to 'plugin-sdk/'.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads the plugin SDK entrypoints JSON file and returns a set of subpaths that are considered entrypoints, excluding 'index'.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts the subpath following 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/' from a module specifier if present; otherwise returns null.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Collects and returns a list of violations where module specifiers referencing 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/' subpaths are not properly exported or included in entrypoints. Returns a sorted array of violation objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the violation collection and reports the results; exits with status code 1 if violations are found.
